headline: Fire breaks out at Secretariat building, quickly extinguished by staff
summary: A fire erupted on the second floor of the Secretariat building Tuesday evening due to a short circuit. Staff used extinguishers to put out the blaze before firefighters arrived.
details: A fire broke out at a Secretariat building on Tuesday evening, but was quickly extinguished by staff before firefighters could arrive. The incident occurred around 6:45 PM.
According to the Fire Service and Civil Defence, flames erupted on the second floor of the building. A short circuit in the ceiling above a bathroom is believed to have caused the fire.
A Fire Service unit was dispatched to the scene. However, they did not need to intervene as building occupants had already put out the fire using extinguishers.
caption:

A fire broke out at a Secretariat building on Tuesday evening, but was quickly extinguished by staff before firefighters could arrive. The incident occurred around 6:45 PM.

According to the Fire Service and Civil Defence, flames erupted on the second floor of the building. A short circuit in the ceiling above a bathroom is believed to have caused the fire.

A Fire Service unit was dispatched to the scene. However, they did not need to intervene as building occupants had already put out the fire using extinguishers.
